Thanks for the focused fix and regression coverage. On review, parallel EventBus dispatch has no production consumer in Coco; Manager and plugin listeners use sequential dispatch. We decided to remove the unused mode, so this PR is superseded by #541. The successor preserves sequential error handling and adds regression coverage. Closing this PR in favor of that simplification.
